entities.name: Clachan
entities.description: A small village inhabited by kithkin on Lorwyn; Shadowmoor counterpart is a doun.

entities.name: Ballyrush
entities.description: Clachan known for springjacks and smithing; doun equivalent Ballynock.

entities.name: Burrenton
entities.description: Large clachan near Spinerock Knoll known for smiths and bottled fires.

entities.name: Cloverdell
entities.description: Large clachan with lush meadows protected by treefolk.

entities.name: Duinshyle
entities.description: Smaller remote clachan reachable by air transport.

entities.name: Dundoolin
entities.description: Clachan with a belltower rebuilt by cenn Hyal Lwellen, known for scholars.

entities.name: Hyal Lwellen
entities.description: Cenn of Dundoolin who rebuilt its belltower and established trade with the Paperfin merrows.

entities.name: Goldmeadow
entities.description: Small farming clachan famous for springjacks.

entities.name: Kinsbaile
entities.description: Largest clachan and host of the Festival of Tales.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: Killed the entire population of Kinscaer.

entities.name: Longlake
entities.description: Clachan on a brackish lake known for shipbuilding.

events.summary: Oona kills the entire population of Kinscaer, which has since been repopulated.
events.quote: The entire population of its doun equivalent, Kinscaer , was killed by Oona .

relations.note: Killed the population of its doun equivalent Kinscaer.
